youtube.title: Why Internet Cables Are Twisted 🔌 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Ethernet cables contain four pairs of copper wires, each pair twisted together at a slightly different rate. Signals travel as the difference between the two wires, and twisting makes outside interference hit both wires equally, so the receiver subtracts it away. Twisting also reduces crosstalk between neighboring pairs. Untwisted wires pick up much more noise and carry weaker data.
